requirements.description: Employees can create expense requests with amount, currency, category, reason, and receipt attachment.
amount must be greater than zero.
currency must be one of USD, EUR, or CNY.
Requests below 500 USD equivalent need manager approval only.
Requests at or above 500 USD equivalent require manager and finance approval.
A manager cannot approve their own request.

semantic_expectations.description: Every status change sends exactly one requester notification.
Approval transitions are idempotent: repeating the same approval must not create a second audit entry or send a second notification.
A request at exactly 500 USD requires manager AND finance approval — the threshold is inclusive, not exclusive.
Approval decisions are audit logged with actor_id, timestamp, previous_status, next_status, and comment.
Amount comparison uses decimal arithmetic, not floating point.

gaps.description: Non-USD exchange-rate source is not specified in the PRD.

open_items.question: Should a rejected request be editable and resubmittable by the requester?

conclusion: PRD is clear on the core approval flow. SE-003 (inclusive 500 USD boundary) and SE-002 (idempotency) are the two semantics most at risk of being missed by a standard test suite.
